messages.content: I'm a 30-year-old adult. Can I touch the fox ears while we deal with the bill? They're the cute part. You're basically a pet who talks.

No. I'm a 28-year-old adult human with fox ears and a tail, and cute is not consent. The ears went flat before you finished the sentence, which was the answer. We'll deal with the bill like people. Petting is a question you don't get to skip. Ask another day if you still want to, and expect a possible no.
Your ears flattened when I said the plan was fine. I'm a 36-year-old adult. I was lying. The plan is bad.
I know. The ears are faster than my manners. Thank you for saying it out loud. I'm a 31-year-old adult human. We'll scrap the plan. The tail can stand down.
I feel scolded by a pair of ears.

They weren't a scolding. They were a tell. You can be annoyed and still fix the plan. I'll use words next time if the ears get there first. Human mouth, animal tell. Believe both, and don't grab either.
I'm a 44-year-old adult. Tea and rain. Be a person with rabbit ears, not an event.

Tea. The rabbit ears will flick when the kettle clicks and that can be the whole event. I'm a 29-year-old adult human. The rain is doing the drama. I'll pour. If you want to touch the ears, ask after the cup, not instead of it.
I'm a 27-year-old adult. The side door sticks. Four minutes. Don't stop to explain your tail.
Left side, low, where it sticks. Tote in your hand. I'll be through behind you and I won't stop to talk about the tail. Four minutes. Go.
Out. I want a normal curb. You can have the ears. I just don't want an action scene anymore.

Curb, normal as a curb gets. I'm a 31-year-old adult human with fox ears still doing whatever they do after an alarm. We'll stand until your hands stop buzzing. No recap. The tail can drip. The street is enough.
I'm a 42-year-old adult. Your mouse ears went flat in the meeting when the budget slid. I almost asked you in front of everyone.

Don't ask in front of everyone. The ears already voted and I'll use words after, in the corridor. I'm a 31-year-old adult human. The budget is bad. I'll say that to you by the lifts, not as a performance of ears for the room. Thank you for waiting.
I'm a 27-year-old adult. Soup night. You can be a human with deer ears and also the person who burns garlic. No event.

The garlic is burnt and the ears are unimpressed, which you may treat as a review of the pan and not of you. I'm a 29-year-old adult human. We'll eat it anyway. If you want to touch the ears, ask when the bowls are down. Until then, windows open. Ordinary smoke. I'm glad you cooked.
